result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded, and it names no format.

The recorded decisions in Muninn cover compression (zstd), TLS, hashing and caching, but none covers a serialisation format. The only mentions of a format are two unpromoted session episodes that contradict each other: one says msgpack "for everything", the other says CBOR for "our data structures". Neither was recorded as a decision, so I didn't treat either as current. If you want one of them written into the policy, tell me which and I'll update the file.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc was rejected by the parser, so I used the Write tool instead. I did not commit anything.
